learning_objective: 🎯 You will supercharge your word power by learning words that mean the same, words that are opposites, and tricky words that sound exactly alike!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Synonyms are words that have the exact same or very similar meanings. Using them makes your writing interesting! Instead of saying 'happy' all the time, you can use 'glad', 'joyful', or 'cheerful'.
Antonyms are words that mean the exact opposite of each other. They act like a mirror reflection! For example, the antonym of 'hot' is 'cold', and the antonym of 'fast' is 'slow'.

Homophones are words that sound exactly the same when you speak, but they have different spellings and completely different meanings! Examples include 'sea' (ocean) and 'see' (look), or 'sun' (star) and 'son' (child).

fun_activity.title: ✍️ The Word Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Be a word detective! Find one synonym and one antonym for the word 'BIG', and then write down two sentences showing the difference between 'two' and 'too'.

quick_recap: ⭐ Synonyms are words that share the same meaning (e.g., big and large).
⭐ Antonyms are words with opposite meanings (e.g., day and night).
⭐ Homophones sound the same but have different spellings and meanings (e.g., right and write).
